g.text: Fixed local15 radii, z=0 and 3+3 point rings; full 15-pair Hessian. Frozen-phase snapshots, not Floquet/Lyapunov exponents.
Relative phase varies on the counterrotating orbit; snapshot eigenvalues alone do not decide stability.
